notes.title: April Status Update
notes.notes:
Future versions of Desktop+ will come with a copy of Chromium bundled in to allow a more immersive experience. The install size of the app will then be roughly 53x of the current one.

RAM upgrade is recommended in preparation of these changes.

I'm also happy to announce that Desktop+ is now officially Steam Deck Unsupported.

That's all for now.

Update on the Update:
Contents of this announcement may be at odds with the truth. Always make sure date and time are set correctly on your computer.
